title: Clearer API docs and broader MCP support
summary:
Clearer API examples, less stale model lists, and a little pruning in the community showcase.

The API docs gained clearer audio, vision, and request-body examples. Version 1.0.6 of @pollinations/model-context-protocol adds support for Node.js 14 and 15, with installation and troubleshooting guidance.

Requests to /openai/models now bypass caching, so model-list changes such as qwen-reasoning and phi-mini can appear without waiting for a stale response to expire.

Riffle, which uses Pollinations to work readers’ vocabulary words into English-reading content, was added to the project listings. The TeekGenAI listing was removed; neither change alters the image API.
